turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Chris calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Bethany Hickman?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Can I also confirm the email we have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, that's still the one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $1,110.72.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can't pay the whole thing. My shifts at the plant got cut back in Apr.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you don't pay today we'll take you to court and garnish your wages.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file so hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll try to pay $156 the 15th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $156.20 on September 15. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will you be paying through the app or online banking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Through the app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
